items.reason: A once-nightly leave-on gel that suits an adult who wants to work on the look of uneven texture.
A mineral SPF 50 for daytime, since adapalene can leave skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Since three months of chemist products have made no visible difference, we'd suggest seeing a dermatologist or doctor, as that is beyond what a shop can help with, so we haven't added more products. Meanwhile, use the gel at night on dry skin, starting every second night, and wear the SPF every morning.
